Hero.headline: Pass your provisional driving license exam with confidence
Hero.subheadline: Practice under real, timed conditions across Rwanda's Highway Code. Your first exam attempt is completely free.

Categories.title: Practice by topic
Categories.subtitle: Five topic areas covering the provisional driving license syllabus.

cat1.name: Road Signs and Signals
cat1.description: Recognize and interpret traffic signs, road markings, and signals.

cat2.name: Right-of-Way and Priority Rules
cat2.description: Know who moves first at intersections, roundabouts, and around emergency vehicles.

cat3.name: Driving Maneuvers and Lane Discipline
cat3.description: Overtaking, lane changes, turns, stopping, and parking.

cat4.name: Speed Limits and Vehicle Dimensions
cat4.description: Legal speed limits and size and weight rules under Rwandan law.

cat5.name: Highway Code — General Knowledge
cat5.description: 319 questions covering the full provisional driving code.

Pricing.title: Affordable, flexible pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Pick the bundle that matches how often you want to practice.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Common questions about pricing, attempts, and how practice works.

q1.question: How much does it cost?
q1.answer: Your first practice exam is completely free. After that, top up your wallet and continue for a small fee per attempt.

q2.question: What happens if I don't pass?
q2.answer: There's no limit on practice attempts — top up and try again as many times as you like until you feel ready.

q3.question: Can I review my mistakes?
q3.answer: Yes. Once you finish an exam, you'll see your score and an explanation for every question, including the ones you got wrong.

q4.question: What languages are supported?
q4.answer: The site is available in English, Kinyarwanda, and French. Exam questions themselves are currently in Kinyarwanda only.
